metadata.source: OWASP Testing Guide, OWASP API Security Top 10

description: IDOR occurs when app exposes direct reference to internal object (ID) without authorization check.

testing: Change ID by 1, check if other user data returned
Minimal proof, not full PII extraction
methodology.evidence: Request as user A to ID of user B returns 200 with other user data (redact PII)
methodology.verification: Reproduce with two accounts, confirm authz missing

witness: Change id in body, URL, etc.

remediation: Authorization check for every request, random IDs (UUID), deny by default
